title: Roman numerals both ways
prompt:
Implement `to_roman(n)` and `from_roman(s)` in app/roman.py for 1..3999 (standard subtractive form: IV, IX, XL,
XC, CD, CM). Out-of-range numbers raise `ValueError`; `from_roman` accepts lowercase but raises `ValueError` for
anything that is not the canonical form (e.g. "IIII", "VX", "IC", "MMMM", "").
